products.notes: 8-ch processor with integrated iDatalink Maestro (3Sixty.3-based). 4 balanced RCA in (up to 4 V), 4 high-level in (up to 12.5 V, signal-sense turn-on 4-16 V), 2 AUX RCA (up to 2 V), SPDIF coax. 8 RCA out up to 4 V RMS, 200 ohm. EQ: 31 bands per channel group (Front/Spare/Rear/Sub), Q 0.01-10; 245 EQ bands total. Up to 10 ms delay per channel. SNR >100 dBA. 32-bit 147 MIPS DSP, 24-bit DAC (108 dB DR). Tuning via Rockford Fosgate PerfectTune PC software or iOS/Android app.
